Summaries.eng: Lingwu Continent is a world where spiritual power and martial soul coexist. Spiritual cultivation moves mountains and rivers, while martial artists tear apart heaven and earth with their bare hands. The former genius of Xingchen Town was Chentian. At the age of ten, his martial soul fell silent and his spiritual sea dried up. From then on, he became a waste of his family and suffered from the cold eyes of others. In a life and death struggle, Chen Tian fell off a cliff and mistakenly entered the large formation arranged by the ancient Sword Emperor. Under the influence of the power of the Heavenly Book, he awakened his spiritual and martial dual cultivation physique. At the same time, he also obtained an unfamiliar memory and a mysterious storage ring. From then on, he rose up against adversity, broke through the cycle of the Heavenly Dao Palm, and finally crossed the shackles of the Emperor's Tribulation to conquer the spiritual and martial continent!
